title: dispatch-table.yml
description: The only place ingest names sinks: which writer handles an artifact, in what order, and where a thought's id comes from. Read only by dispatch-targets.

writer.description: A script beside dispatch-targets, or else a function in $AGENT_LIB/functions.

supplies_id.description: This writer's per-thought result becomes the thought record's id. Written first; if it fails, the thought's other targets are not attempted.

batch.description: true: called as <writer> write VAULT MANIFEST for all its thoughts at once. false: called as <writer> --path P --thought JSON per thought.
